rows.synopsis: Orphaned sisters Sabrina and Daphne are shipped to a grandmother they have never met, in a town where fairy tales turn out to be real.
rows.situation: After their parents vanished, sixth foster home means Ferryport Landing and a claim from a stranger named Relda Grimm that she is their grandmother, their father Henry was skilled at tall tales, and fairy-tale characters called Everafters are real. A midnight escape attempt ends with pixie stings, granny rules, and a giant attacking the house.
rows.coping: Sabrina protects Daphne the only way she knows how, planning their escape and refusing to trust anyone, while Daphne keeps talking them both into being brave. When the giant is real, Sabrina makes her first choice as a guardian: she can keep Daphne safe, or she can save the only family they have left, and they choose the rescue together.

rows.per_story_synopsis: Sabrina and Daphne Grimm arrive in Ferryport Landing as their sixth foster placement, certain the woman claiming to be their grandmother is an impostor, since their parents always said their real grandmother died before they were born. Relda Grimm welcomes them with spaghetti, letters from their mother, and a smell-like-a-dead-skunk candy, then drops the truth: Everafters are real, and the girls' ancestors brought them here. A midnight runaway ends in pixie stings and house rules, and before the girls can decide what to believe, a giant tears into the night and takes Relda and Mr. Canis. The sisters, who talked themselves into being brave on the Coney Island Ferris wheel, decide to rescue them.

rows.synopsis: On the run from the mayor's police force, the sisters uncover a message from their parents that changes everything.
rows.situation: The fairy Puck, who insists he is not Peter Pan, interrogates the girls in a swimming pool and joins the hunt despite his villain claims. Officer Hamstead turns out to be one of the three little pigs, Mayor Charming wants the Grimms at the station before tomorrow's ball, and Relda's hidden note sends them to the forbidden room, where a mirror holds the answers.
rows.coping: Sabrina admits the truth Daphne has been carrying since the parents vanished: her word stopped mattering. She apologizes and hands Daphne the lead, and the sisters work the mystery as a team, house password, giant lore, deal theory, and the forbidden-room note, growing into the detective family their parents' letter promises.

rows.per_story_synopsis: The rescue begins with capture: Puck nets the sisters in a swimming pool, takes them for spies, and ends up grudgingly along, while Elvis leads the girls home past Officer Hamstead, who is one of the three little pigs and loyal to Relda. Mayor Charming orders the Grimms collected before his fundraising ball, and the girls bolt again, unlocking the house's 13 doors with Daphne's persistence. Inside, a hidden note in their mother's handwriting directs them to the forbidden room, where the magic mirror awaits, and Sabrina, sorry for not listening, finally follows Daphne's lead. What stares back is a face in a mirror demanding to know who they are.

rows.synopsis: With a magic carpet, a jailbreak, and a fairy tale disguise, the sisters crash the mayor's ball hunting for Granny Relda.
rows.situation: The magic mirror confirms Relda and Canis are alive in the giant's pocket and recommends Jack of beanstalk fame, currently in jail, so the girls charm a jailbreak out of Ichabod Crane. They fly out on a magic carpet with the giant in pursuit, regroup at the house for disguise wands, then sneak into Charming's mansion during the fundraising ball.
rows.coping: The sisters plan like the detective family they are becoming: mirror consultations, a coached jailbreak, carpet steering by voice, and a deliberate choice to save Granny before chasing their parents, because Dad would want his mom saved too. Jack, once somebody special and now a thief in the clink, finds being needed again, and the team splits missions by radio.

rows.per_story_synopsis: The mirror shows Relda and Canis alive inside the giant's pocket and points the sisters to Jack, the giant slayer turned shoplifting jailbird, so they conjure a jailbreak by scaring Ichabod Crane with a headless-horseman threat. The magic carpet getaway brings the giant down on them until the rug poops out, and back at the house, a disguise wand turns Sabrina into a Mama Bear and Daphne into the Nutcracker before Jack lays out the plan: get the map at the ball, cause a distraction, save Relda first, parents second. In Charming's mansion, full of Beauty and the Beast and a mayor whose charity lines his pockets, the disguised girls blow their cover the moment they walk in.

rows.synopsis: At Mayor Charming's ball, the sisters discover the Everafters are trapped in Ferryport Landing, that the Scarlet Hand holds their parents, and that Jack has betrayed them.
rows.situation: Under disguise, Sabrina and Daphne work Charming's party and learn the truth from Snow White and the guests: the barrier stays up only while a Grimm lives in town, the Everafters are trapped, and Henry and Veronica were taken by the Scarlet Hand, the source of the red handprints. Charming is caught profiting off giant-destroyed land, and the kerchief Jack gave them leads the giant straight to them.
rows.coping: Daphne's optimism carries Sabrina through the betrayal: maybe everyone here hates us, but I have you, and Daphne says she is glad to have her too. Prince Charming, insulted but honorable, insists on joining them back to the house, where Jack's plunder is waiting, and the sisters choose to fight on with new allies instead of running.

rows.per_story_synopsis: The ball is a minefield of discoveries: the Everafters are prisoners of the barrier the Grimms maintain, Snow White confirms the Scarlet Hand took Henry and Veronica, and Mayor Charming is exposed for buying up land the giant destroys. When the giant crashes the party with Granny and Canis still in its pocket, a kerchief Jack slipped the girls turns out to be the scent trap, and the betrayal stings worse than the pixies. Sabrina tells Daphne she is the best thing she has, Prince Charming swallows his Grimm-hatred to help, and the sisters click the slippers home to a house Jack has already looted for the magic beans.

rows.synopsis: With Charming at their side, the sisters arm themselves with Excalibur to stop Jack before his beans sprout an army of giants.
rows.situation: Jack has robbed the magic mirror and taken the beans, and Charming explains the Scarlet Hand is a shadow group behind unsolved disappearances. The girls suit up from the armory, Charming heals Elvis with the Three Witches, and the team flies to Jack, whose plan is to make the whole town feel important again by summoning giants, because he cannot bear being normal.
rows.coping: Sabrina negotiates instead of attacks, telling Jack he is the author of his own life and can choose another way, and Jack admits the Scarlet Hand made him a deal he cannot back out of. When the giant descends and the last slipper is destroyed, Sabrina loses the way to her parents, and grief hardens her resolve, I have got nothing to lose, as she sends Daphne to safety and stays to face him.

rows.per_story_synopsis: Jack's theft of the beans turns rescue into war: the mirror briefs them on the Scarlet Hand, a shadow network with no known leader, and Charming joins the sisters as a self-declared future enemy with a shared mission. Armed with Excalibur, a sword that answers intent, the team flies out while Sabrina records a voice memo to her missing parents, telling them she trusts Daphne now. The confrontation with Jack lands on its real question, whether a story already written can be rewritten, and Sabrina argues it can. Then the giant comes down, the slipper is lost, and Sabrina's chance to reach her parents is destroyed in the same moment her sister needs her.

rows.synopsis: Jack's giant goes on a rampage, the Scarlet Hand's shadow closes in, and the sisters fight the battle that decides Ferryport Landing's future.
rows.situation: Jack sets the giant on the town and turns Excalibur on the girls, Charming demands a kiss from Snow White to wake, and Canis transforms into the Big Bad Wolf to shield them. Puck returns with his pixies, Granny is freed from the giant's pocket, and Sabrina owns her mistake to the giant himself, I made a mistake, I am sorry, which ends the rampage before Excalibur's nick can kill.
rows.coping: The family closes ranks: Granny reminds Canis of who he really is, Puck comes back for the girls while denying he is a hero, and Sabrina tells the giant the truth about the sword and apologizes. Safely home, Granny reframes the disaster as Grimm training, the mirror confirms the parents' sleep is strong magic but promises a way, and Puck moves in.

rows.per_story_synopsis: The final battle throws everything at once: Jack wields Excalibur on the girls, the Big Bad Wolf rises in Mr. Canis, Snow White's kiss wakes Charming, and Puck's pixies swarm to the rescue just when all seems lost. Granny is freed from the giant's pocket and talks Canis back to himself, and Sabrina ends the giant's rampage the Grimm way, by telling the truth about her mistake and apologizing to a creature twice her size. At home, Granny turns the scars into schooling, the mirror promises a way past the magic holding the parents asleep, and the family gains a freeloading fairy. The Scarlet Hand remains in the shadows, and the sisters are Grimms now, trained, tested, and ready.

rows.synopsis: Sabrina and Daphne start at a new school, hopeful for a taste of normal life.
rows.situation: After the Everafter War, the sisters try ordinary life at a new school, hoping to be kids instead of detectives for a change. How long the normal lasts, and what follows them in, is the season's opening question.
rows.coping: The sisters carry what the last year taught them, bravery talked into being, trust rebuilt one honest conversation at a time, into a place where nobody knows their name.
